examples.label: See every record for a domain

notes:
Record types:
 A -> IPv4 | AAAA -> IPv6 | CNAME -> alias | MX -> mail | NS -> name server
 TXT -> text (SPF/verification) | SOA -> zone authority | SRV -> service | PTR -> reverse
Hosts file: /etc/hosts (Linux), C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts (Windows)
 Format: <IP>  <hostname> [alias ...]   e.g. 192.168.1.20  testserver.local
Public resolvers: 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1
